answer: Clones can fake credentials but not usefulness to strangers. Give an identity weight only through receipts signed by counterparties it served, then pass those receipts through a prism: flows circling inside one tight cluster refract to almost nothing, like meltwater vanishing into a dune, while receipts from many unconnected neighborhoods keep their strength. Influence accrues glacier-slow, one real cross-community service at a time. A sybil ring trading with itself mints plain paper; to matter, each fake must do real work for real outsiders — exactly the cost being many was meant to avoid.
